title: Made a vibe coding game engine for agents
author: xirrel
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1uy4mca/video/3dcpjb15oldh1/player

I've been building a game engine for AI in rust and luau for 4 months with a good friend of mine. Basically the idea we have is that users can use their own coding agent e.g claude code to vibe code and publish games. For example [https://origozero.ai/world/lumi/cloth-and-fabric](https://origozero.ai/world/lumi/cloth-and-fabric) was made and published with a single prompt. I think we have built something cool and would like to hear your opinion. Its free to use since tokens come from your personal claude or codex subscriptions.

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: So is this an MCP server of it's own standalone thing?

replies.author: xirrel
replies.body:
Yes. We have a mcp server if you want to run the editor in browser and agent locally and it bridges the connection. We also have a standalone native app that has mcp and it also has integration for agents so it is like a one stop shop and you can use claude inside the engine. Basically it functions as an IDE
